This '''walled-off community''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prine]] was the village that [[Maddie]] and [[Yan]] called home. While a majority of Prine's surface consisted of desert terrain, Maddie's home village was built on a hilly, grassy area which was usable for agriculture. Yan was killed and Maddie abducted by a [[Unidentified caravan|gang]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] after venturing outside the safety of the walls. However, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]] managed to return home on a [[Unidentified bovid species|bovid]] after being rescued by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]].
